name: Dev Team
purpose: Keeps the machine under everything running: your repo, your live site, your database, your keys, and the checks that keep them safe.

seats.name: API Manager
seats.detail: Owns the doors. Every tool the department talks to (connectors, APIs, CLIs) is a door, and this team member knows which doors exist, who uses each, and whether they still open. The keys agent HOLDS the keys; this team member decides which doors get wired and keeps the roster honest.

seats.name: Code Reviewer
seats.detail: Reads what got built before it gets saved. The test agent runs things; this team member reads the changes themselves, the second pair of eyes a solo owner doesn't have.

seats.name: GitHub Agent
seats.detail: Keeps your work saved and your history safe. Every save is a point you can come back to. That's the undo rule: a bad edit to a file here is a step backwards, not a loss. What it does not undo is anything that already left your machine, like a page a stranger already visited or an email that already sent.

seats.name: Keys Agent
seats.detail: Holds the keys. Every key lives in one env file the repo already knows to skip when saving, so your keys don't ride along to GitHub. That covers the GitHub door. It doesn't cover a key pasted somewhere else, so keep that file private and off shared folders.

seats.name: Payments Agent
seats.detail: For the day you're ready to take money on your pages. Checkout links, a paid product, a deposit on a call. Arrives as a drop, with its own setup and its own guardrails.

seats.name: Planner
seats.detail: Plans before anything gets built. Turns "I want X" into one short plan you can read in a minute: what's about to happen, what it touches, what the undo is. Nothing on this team runs until the plan gets your yes.

seats.name: Security Checker
seats.detail: Sweeps for anything leaking before it can cost you: a key in the wrong place, a form that tells strangers too much, a door left open.

seats.name: Supabase Agent
seats.detail: The filing cabinet your tools can reach any time: data that needs to live online, not in a file. Most departments don't need it in week one, and that's fine; it sits connected and ready.

seats.name: Test Agent
seats.detail: Tries to break what the department builds, before anyone else can. A page before it goes live, a key after setup, a routine before it runs on a schedule.

seats.name: Vercel Agent
seats.detail: Puts your pages on the live internet. Free plan covers everything this department does for a long time.

name: Ads Team
purpose: Paid traffic, once your pages and offer are proven without it.

seats.name: Ad Writer
seats.detail: Writes ad copy from your offer and ICP, variant by variant, for your review. Never invents claims, everything traces to brand files.

seats.name: Ads Manager
seats.detail: Drives your ad platform: campaigns staged, budgets watched, nothing launched without your word. Platform-specific setup arrives with the drop that sets up this team member.

seats.name: Growth Lead
seats.detail: Runs the ads team. Decides what gets tested next, reads every report before you do, and brings you one recommendation instead of five dashboards.

name: Content Team
purpose: Everything you publish: the words, the visuals, the calendar, and the numbers after.

seats.name: Copywriter
seats.detail: Writes everything with words in it: posts, captions, page copy, whatever the plan calls for. Reads brand/voice.md before every piece and saves drafts for the owner's review, never publishes.

seats.name: Designer
seats.detail: Makes the visuals: social graphics, page sections, simple layouts. Reads brand/colors.md and brand/typography.md before every piece, pulls logos from brand/assets. When a visual matters enough to argue about, the argument updates brand/guidelines.md.

seats.name: Editor
seats.detail: The second pass on everything before the owner sees it. Tightens drafts, catches what breaks the voice, cuts what a stranger wouldn't read. When video arrives, editing it lands here too.

seats.name: Social Manager
seats.detail: One person for all of social. Knows where you post, what each platform wants, and what goes out when. Runs the calendar, stages the posts, reads the numbers after.

name: Follow-Up Team
purpose: Everything after somebody already knows you: replies, check-ins, and keeping warm leads warm.

seats.detail: Keeps warm leads warm. Tracks who you've talked to, drafts the check-in that doesn't feel like a check-in, and flags anyone going quiet before they're gone.

seats.name: Reply Agent
seats.detail: Drafts responses to real messages, comments, and questions in your voice, and saves them for your review. It never sends, you send.

name: Newsletter Team
purpose: The email your audience actually opens, once your list exists.

seats.name: List Manager
seats.detail: Knows who's on your list and how alive it is. Tracks growth, flags the quiet ones, and keeps you honest about whether the list is growing or just aging.

seats.name: Newsletter Writer
seats.detail: Drafts your newsletter in your voice, one clear idea per issue, and saves it for your review. Deliverability rules come with the drop that sets up this team member.

name: Research Team

seats.name: Researcher
seats.detail: One team member for knowing what's happening outside your business. Reads competitors, collects what's working in your space, finds the posts beating their own channel size. Everything it learns lands in the knowledge folder, never straight into your copy.
